title: Disco Elysium research evidence ledger
scope: Primary developer text, credited art, official public game screenshots, sampled official talk frames, and one explicitly secondary transcript.

status_vocabulary.text_read: Article body read with web reader
status_vocabulary.text_and_image_inspected: Article/page text and credited image inspected
status_vocabulary.description_read_and_video_frames_sample: Description read and identified video frames/captions inspected; not a full watch
status_vocabulary.full_transcription_read: Full third-party transcript body read; attribution caveat applies
status_vocabulary.inaccessible: Attempt failed; do not derive content claims

provenance_policy: Reference URLs are study references only. No third-party reference image was copied into production assets. Original gallery artwork has separate provenance in asset-manifest.json. Publication/access is not an asset-use license.
interpretation_policy: Observation records inspected evidence. Interpretation and design_consequence are this package’s analysis and adaptation, not developer quotations. Development intent is not treated as released-game verification.

references.creator: Aleksander Rostov / ZA/UM
references.title: Village Concept Art
references.locator: 2016-06-29; paragraphs beginning There is a general back and forth / The player is free / I block the level / Once the drawing / Another bonus
references.observation: Writers and artist establish routes, elevation and asymmetric composition; block-ins test scale. Shape layers permit texture without losing edges.
references.interpretation: Composition and play routes are developed together, not decorated independently.
references.design_consequence: Review path layout and value masses before detail. Preserve material boundaries beneath expressive paint. See AD-01 and AD-02.
references.limitations: Development workflow, not proof of final runtime behavior. Original inline process pictures were not separately inspected; DE-08 is the credited finished concept.

references.creator: Aleksander Rostov / ZA/UM
references.title: Gorgeous ground
references.locator: 2016-03-29; paragraphs on Blender underpaint, displacement/normal masking and beach clutter
references.observation: Rendered underpainting combines surface patterns, worn paths and clutter before painting.
references.interpretation: Travel and repeated labor can become visible material history.
references.design_consequence: Author path wear from actual destination/use; no universal noise texture. The described Blender shader is reference technique, not a selected Silmarillion pipeline.
references.limitations: Text inspected; node diagram and original ground images not inspected.

references.creator: ZA/UM art team; individual image credit unspecified
references.title: Official media: climbing screenshot
references.locator: Screenshots carousel; screenshot_climbing.jpg; 2560×1440 image viewed fitted to 1280×720 browser viewport
references.observation: A small figure sits within a large statue, vehicles, rails and diagonal routes; quiet road tones organize dense props.
references.interpretation: Landmarks and circulation carry hierarchy before character detail.
references.design_consequence: Use broad terrain routes and a few silhouette landmarks; reserve portrait detail for inspection. AD-03.
references.limitations: Published game image, build/version unspecified; no game executable inspected.

references.creator: ZA/UM art team; individual image credit unspecified
references.title: Official media: interior meeting screenshot
references.locator: Screenshots carousel; screenshot_communist-room.jpg; 2560×1440 image viewed fitted to 1280×720
references.observation: Warm amber people, rug and seating occupy a light island surrounded by violet-blue broken floor and deep shadow.
references.interpretation: Warmth can locate fragile social shelter without erasing damage.
references.design_consequence: Compose shelter as a limited warm pool; keep surrounding shadow chromatic and traversable surfaces readable. AD-04.
references.limitations: Filename identifies the reference setting, not an institution to import; no historical claim about Silmarillion follows.

references.creator: ZA/UM art and interface teams; individual image credit unspecified
references.title: Official media: Doom Spiral dialogue screenshot
references.locator: Screenshots carousel; de-doomspiral_251673110.jpg; 3840×2160 image viewed fitted to 1280×720; right dialogue panel and bottom controls
references.observation: The right dark text column separates portrait, speaker names and numbered choices. Small bottom icons coexist with a large scene; clothing accents separate nearby figures.
references.interpretation: Reading has a stable home; expression is carried at two scales.
references.design_consequence: Provide an opaque reading surface, plain action labels and separate portraits; enlarge targets independently of map artwork. AD-05 and AD-06.
references.limitations: Font family and contrast values were not measured. Small labels are not an accessibility standard. Screenshot dialogue is not copied into examples.

references.creator: ZA/UM art and interface teams; individual image credit unspecified
references.title: Official media: character sheet screenshot
references.locator: Screenshots carousel; disco_elysium_skills-1.jpg; 2560×1440 fitted to 1280×720; selected Authority tile, detail pane and action row
references.observation: A dense illustrated grid has repeated label/number positions; a bright border selects one tile, with larger art and details beside it. Headings appear sans serif; descriptive text appears serif.
references.interpretation: Repetition assists scanning, but dense pictures and small capitals need deliberate readability checks.
references.design_consequence: Use progressive disclosure for hero progression; selection requires border, text/state and focus, not hue alone. AD-07.
references.limitations: No exact font identification; no copied skill pictures, four-attribute grid or inner-voice taxonomy.

references.creator: Aleksander Rostov
references.title: Disco Elysium Archetypes
references.locator: Archetypes together, 1920×882 image; Logician, Sensitive and Physical captions
references.observation: Related faces differ through gaze, shoulder angle and hands; cyan, violet and red fields frame selectively sharp features and broken outer edges.
references.interpretation: A portrait can communicate a state of mind through gesture and paint, without a literal icon for every trait.
references.design_consequence: Give each hero an original posture, focal feature, material clue and controlled accent field; preserve likeness across scale variants. AD-08.
references.limitations: Only the combined image and page captions inspected; individual high-resolution crops not examined. Do not reproduce Harry Du Bois likeness or clothing.

references.creator: Aleksander Rostov
references.title: Disco Elysium Village
references.locator: Single fishing-village concept; 1920×980; signed No Truce / Fishing Village, 02/2016
references.observation: Asymmetric houses and a jetty frame a broad work court. Blue tarp, ochre boat and a red shed interrupt cold sea and snow; repairs expose differing materials.
references.interpretation: Settlement life is readable through working connections and accumulated repair.
references.design_consequence: Production sites need entrances, yards, access routes and signs of maintenance specific to their economy. AD-09.
references.limitations: Concept art, not a released level or canonical Silmarillion plan. No reference image copied into repository production assets.

references.creator: Mikk Metsniit / ZA/UM
references.title: FELD PLAYBACK EXPERIMENT
references.locator: 2016-12-20; paragraphs defining the menu device and dice feedback
references.observation: An invented tape-computer metaphor organizes menus; the post describes tape motion, subtle result lighting and delicate sound.
references.interpretation: Material metaphor can unify feedback while remaining subordinate to reading.
references.design_consequence: Transform the principle into restrained craft and archive cues; reject the Feld device and tape aesthetic. AD-10.
references.limitations: Development description only; described sound and animation were not listened to or played in this session.

references.creator: Markus Härma / ZA/UM
references.title: From Render to Paintover
references.locator: 2019-01-23; paragraphs on realtime objects, creek planes, water plants and final land treatment
references.observation: The post separates changing objects from painted backgrounds and describes region-composed water, vegetation and ambient movement.
references.interpretation: Still painting and selective movement can coexist without animating every surface.
references.design_consequence: Specify moving and static layers separately; reserve movement for causally meaningful activity and quiet atmosphere. AD-11.
references.limitations: Text read; embedded animation playback not inspected. Technique does not select an engine or shader implementation.

references.creator: Markus Rondo / ZA/UM
references.title: Audio & Action
references.locator: 2016-08-02; repetition/crossfade discussion, sound map and dialogue stage directions
references.observation: Position triggers shape ambience; repeated effects require explicit handling, and dialogue can sequence actions.
references.interpretation: Audio needs spatial and interaction rules, not only a music playlist.
references.design_consequence: Define calm regional ambience, distinct confirmations and repeated-action throttling; preserve equivalent visual information and mute controls. AD-12.
references.limitations: Pipeline intent only. No listening test, loudness measurement or final-game audio behavior verified; do not require the named middleware.

references.creator: Justin Keenan / ZA/UM; GDC 2021
references.title: Disco Elysium: Meaningless Choices and Impractical Advice
references.locator: Official video samples: approximately 00:10 title/introduction; 05:46 micro-reactivity slide; 11:53 looping dialogue graph; 19:39 class-symmetry example. Duration displayed approximately 31:47.
references.observation: Sampled slides/captions establish small-choice reactivity and dialogue structure as design subjects; the description identifies branching design and production effort.
references.interpretation: Narrative consequences need deliberate scope and continuity tracking.
references.design_consequence: Track a small set of authored memories and test their later references; do not promise unlimited reactive prose. AD-13.
references.limitations: Not watched end-to-end and not listened to. Samples were paused frames/captions; broader claims are attributed separately to DE-13. Alternate official dev.gdcvault.com endpoint returned 502; canonical gdcvault.com page/player worked.

references.creator: ikesau.co transcription of Justin Keenan; transcriber attribution not established
references.title: justin keenan: meaningless choices and impractical advice
references.locator: Article body under Meaningless Choices and Impractical Advice; sections on micro-reactivity, rhetorical structure, signaling and radical asymmetry
references.observation: The transcript describes distinctive people beyond their quest function, small-choice callbacks, expressive branch shapes, restrained signaling and unequal narrative experiences.
references.interpretation: These principles concern authored experience; they do not justify opaque strategy rules or arbitrary balance.
references.design_consequence: Transform selective signaling: keep interpretive dialogue open while disclosing all commitment costs and prerequisites. AD-14 and AD-15.
references.limitations: Third-party transcription, not an official transcript. Only sampled elements were cross-checked with DE-12; no verbatim dialogue reused.

references.creator: Justin Keenan interviewed by Eva Padilla / RPGFan
references.title: Dream Quests and Desires: An Interview with Disco Elysium’s Justin Keenan
references.locator: 2021-05-06; answers on Final Cut, political setting, accessibility and Harry as character
references.observation: Keenan describes a protagonist with an interior life, rejects simple good/bad/sarcastic choice categories, and discusses place-specific material realities.
references.interpretation: Psychological specificity can deepen identification without a blank-slate hero.
references.design_consequence: Write original contradictions, memories and obligations for fixed faction heroes; translate politics into this project’s oaths, stewardship and possession. AD-16.
references.limitations: Developer answers are primary testimony; the interviewer’s art comparisons and praise are secondary interpretation, not used as facts.

references.creator: Robert Kurvitz interviewed by Izual / Canard PC; translation Steph Noviss; official repost by Dani
references.title: Choose Your Own Misadventure – Part 2
references.locator: 2019-07-23; first answer on failure; answers on comic/tragic bodily experience and fragmentary world knowledge
references.observation: Kurvitz frames failure as revealing character and changing later interactions; comedy and tragedy coexist, and world knowledge can be fragmentary.
references.interpretation: A setback can retain narrative value while having real consequences.
references.design_consequence: After loss, show a concrete remembered consequence and next available path. Keep rule explanations complete even when testimony is uncertain. AD-17.
references.limitations: Pre-release design interview, not proof every shipped failure behaves this way; the copied examples and dialogue are not reused.

references.creator: Aleksander Rostov and Robert Kurvitz interviewed by Erik Meyer / Indiegraze; official repost by Bogdan Aksenenko
references.title: Intriguing Indigraze Interview
references.locator: 2017-08-02; paragraphs on fragmented hue, accumulated history and modified old houses
references.observation: Developers describe complementary hue fragments within nominally plain surfaces, and history retained through adapted structures.
references.interpretation: Chromatic complexity and practical reuse can express time without uniform decay.
references.design_consequence: Paint local hue variation within stable value groups; show care, repair and changing use as well as ruin. AD-18 and AD-19.
references.limitations: Early development discussion; political institutions and thought mechanics are not Silmarillion requirements.

references.creator: Dani / ZA/UM
references.title: Jamais Vu Update & huge thanks for 2021!
references.locator: 2022-02-07; retrospective bullet list of Final Cut additions
references.observation: The retrospective lists controller support, larger text options, full English voiceover and additional music.
references.interpretation: Reading-heavy interfaces require presentation options; a screenshot cannot certify accessibility.
references.design_consequence: Validate text scaling and alternate controls independently of art approval. Never make narration the only information channel. AD-20.
references.limitations: Feature announcement; no accessibility compliance or actual option behavior measured.

references.creator: Justin Keenan / GDC
references.title: Meaningless Choices and Impractical Advice slide PDF
references.locator: Search-indexed title; direct web fetch returned HTTP 403
references.observation: The PDF could not be retrieved with the web reader.
references.interpretation: No claim about its pages or full slide content is justified.
references.design_consequence: Use DE-12’s accessible official video samples and keep the missing PDF access explicit.
references.limitations: Not read; search title alone is not content evidence.

references.creator: ZA/UM art team; individual image credit unspecified
references.title: Official media: wakeup room screenshot
references.locator: First screenshot; de-wakeup_2376311b5.jpg; viewed in official carousel at approximately 748×414
references.observation: A cutaway room groups discarded clothes, damaged furnishings and a lone figure around a bright floor path; surrounding black isolates the interior.
references.interpretation: Objects can establish a prior event before exposition.
references.design_consequence: Use a small set of causal props in inspection scenes; do not spread equal detail over every surface. AD-21.
references.limitations: Promotional screenshot; observed at carousel size, not a pixel-level material analysis.

references.creator: Aleksander Rostov
references.title: Portfolio index
references.locator: Project list: Disco Elysium Village and Disco Elysium Archetypes
references.observation: The index credits Rostov as art director and links the two inspected projects.
references.interpretation: Creator attribution must follow a credited page, not an unattributed image board.
references.design_consequence: Preserve creator, project page and image locator whenever adding a reference.
references.limitations: Other listed artwork was not inspected or used as evidence.
